guard: historical channel ambient is buffered pull-only so a join backfill can never drive automatic turns, while directed traffic (mentions, DMs) and live ambient keep their automatic delivery
why: The defect this suite exists for shipped and was invisible to every green gate: the live E2E
mesh is seconds old, so no suite ever delivered a message with historical=true into a host-mode
drive loop. On the first real mesh join the backlog arrived as automatic user turns - measured
as 119 injected digests / 0 assistant turns and provider-side emergency compaction before the
seat's first actual work order could run.
The mutations are the three ways the one-line rule can silently rot: dropping the historical
term (the shipped defect verbatim), inverting it to poison directed catch-up (a mention rides
the same flag), and widening it to all ambient (silent degradation of open-mode wake, the same
coin's other face - live peers would stop waking the seat and the mesh would look dead).

mutations.name: M1 the shipped defect: historical no longer forces pull-only
mutations.expectRed: automatic delivery after a 119-message backfill is EXACTLY the live work order

mutations.name: M2 the mention exemption is lost: directed catch-up classified as noise
mutations.expectRed: the historical mention stays automatic while plain history does not

mutations.name: M3 the rule widens to all channel ambient: live traffic stops waking the seat
mutations.expectRed: live channel ambient remains automatic under open attention
